Great to meet earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned:

- Goal: 6-week pilot to validate cost/latency on your analytics ingestion pipelines and measure quality improvements on semantic search.
- Success criteria: 95th pct latency < 120ms for 1k qps test, embedding precision uplift on evaluation set >= 8%.

Action items / next steps:
1) Marissa (me): send pilot SOW and proposed timeline (attached).
2) Alex: confirm technical point-of-contact for infra/test data (we discussed Sam or Priya).
3) Procurement / Legal (Priya): confirm your review timeline and whether you prefer redlines or a short legal call.

Timeline: we'd like to kick off the pilot week of 2026-03-09 to secure dedicated capacity. If procurement needs more lead time, please let me know and we can adjust.

Attachments: Nebula_SOW_v1.pdf (pilot SOW)

Thanks — happy to jump on another quick call if useful.

—Marissa
